name: Fresh Canna | 5g Live Resin | Strawberry Cough
description: Take a deep breath and savor the sweet, fruity rush of Fresh Canna’s Live Resin Wax – Strawberry Cough, a legendary sativa known for its uplifting energy and smooth, flavorful smoke. Made from fresh-frozen cannabis, this terpene-rich live resin wax delivers a bold burst of strawberry sweetness with every dab. With its ripe strawberry, citrus, and earthy spice aroma, Strawberry Cough provides a fast-acting cerebral buzz that enhances focus, creativity, and mood while keeping you feeling light and clear-headed. Whether you're starting your day or sparking inspiration, this strain is the perfect pick-me-up.
